shared_elements: horizontal band or register of repeated pattern
justification: Both surfaces include profile figures, animals, plant/tree forms, and horizontal patterned/register elements, with the most specific overlap being a tree-like plant motif associated with nearby profile figures or animals. The major difference is that A depicts a coherent procession with humans riding or leading horned quadrupeds beside a large tree, whereas B is a stacked, schematic composition of separate signs, animals, and motifs with no comparable riding procession or figure-animal relationship.
